response.justification: Bogdan is a strong systems-level engineer with outstanding, self-directed experience in the geospatial domain through his GISCollective project. His work with DLang on low-latency, high-performance systems is also a significant plus. However, he has a major gap in the core required skill: his commercial C++ experience is nearly a decade old and he has no listed Rust experience. An interview is recommended to determine how transferable his DLang skills are and how quickly he could ramp up on modern C++ or Rust, as his domain knowledge is a rare and valuable asset.
strengths: Exceptional, self-driven experience building a geospatial data platform (GISCollective).
Proven experience with low-latency, high-performance systems programming using DLang.
Demonstrates strong initiative, versatility, and a passion for learning new technologies.
concerns: Lacks recent commercial experience in modern C++ or any experience in Rust, the primary technologies for the role.
No direct experience with routing algorithms, tile generation, or navigation-specific data pipelines.
C++ is not prominently featured in his skills or recent projects, suggesting it is not his area of expertise.
